annotation.title_clean: The Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence / La Déclaration Africaine sur l'Intelligence Artificielle
annotation.title_en: The Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Smart Africa; African Union; African ministers and representatives (Kigali)
annotation.venue: Global AI Summit on Africa, Kigali (C4IR Rwanda)
annotation.summary_en: Bilingual (English/French) declaration signed in Kigali on 4 April 2025 by African states, the African Union and Smart Africa. It sets principles and commitments on AI talent, open data, sovereign compute, markets and sandboxes, and a $60 billion Africa AI Fund, with an emphasis on sovereignty, inclusion and innovation. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guiding principles: sovereignty, inclusivity, harm prevention, privacy, transparency, dignity, sustainability
Establish an African AI Scientific Panel
Framework for open African datasets and open AI models with data governance mechanisms
Distributed sovereign compute and regional HPC data centres
$60 billion Africa AI Fund, Africa-first procurement, and AI and AfCFTA regulatory sandboxes
